headline: Puig to Acquire 75% Stake in Parfums de Marly Owner for €1.2B
summary: Spanish cosmetics group Puig has agreed to acquire a 75% stake in the owner of Parfums de Marly for approximately €1.2 billion.
why: Large cross-border acquisitions in the luxury and beauty sector reshape market concentration and corporate valuations for multinational conglomerates.

impacts.name: Puig Brands, S.A.
impacts.why: Puig is committing €1.2 billion to acquire a 75% stake in the target company.
